{{Quote|Let this be a lesson to those who try to oppose me. I will win this election even if it is the last thing I do. Edwind Vintue is no more and those who follow his steps will find themselves in the same fate as their predecessor...|[[Victor Visalis]]'s journal|<ref name="SWG:J" />}}
'''Edwind Vintue''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived in the city of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was assassinated after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] for having attempted to denounce the illegal activities of Bestine's [[Officer of Defense]] [[Victor Visalis]].<ref name="SWG:J" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Edwind Vintue was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:J" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
